card.name: Final letters of brand and proper names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a rare brand or proper name, mostly the final 'O' of FOUNDAYO (also REZZAYO), where the name is complete. It also fires on the ending of a surname or product name such as DiMatteo and Dermazene.
